description: Hand-written tables for the converter: the tolerance of the amount balance check. The words that point to ingredient classes (technique selection) and to liquids (cup amounts) are language-specific and live in the locale packs: technique-aliases.json and units.json under knowledge/locales/<locale>/.

amountBalance.note: An amount in the steps or the ingredient list may differ from the input by this share, or by one rounding step (gram grid, half a spoon, half a piece), whichever is larger.
